tei:div.tei:p: (401)chos spyod tshul bzhin bya ba'i zin thun thar pa'i sa bon zhes bya ba// (402) bla ma ngag gi dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ tho rangs dang por gnyid khra lhag gis sad pa dang dpa' bo ḍāk+ki ma'i cang te'u dril bu sogs kyi sgras gnyid sad par mos la/ thun bsdam pa'i brdar thun dung gtong tshul mang yang*/ rnying phyogs la shar kaḥthog pa kun mkhyen dam pa bde gshegs kyi lugs srol 'di dpal yul ba'i da lta'i phyag len yin pas/ (Musical notes and signs here) de nas rata gling thugs sgrub las byung ba'i gti mug gnyid dkrog bton nas/ lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun lhod par bca'/ tshe rabs thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang*/ sgom skyon bying rmugs 'thib gsum rlung nag po'i rnam pas phyir 'gro bar bsam ste/ rlung ro lan gsum 'bud/ ngag byin gyis brlab pa sangs gling bla ma dgongs 'dus las byung ba'i bzlas brjod nus pa stobs 'byin gtang*/ nub mo nyal dus bla ma snying dbus su bzhugs pa de tshangs bug lam nas spyi bor byon pa/ pad 'byung (403) longs sku'i chas can la gsol ba btab pas/ de'i 'od zer gyis rang lus sbyangs te lus 'od kyi lce steng rdor sems/ de'i thugs kar rdo rje/ de'i lte bar hūm̐ gsum la/ kā li/ ā li/ yig brgyas bskor ba las 'od zer gyis don gnyis byas mthar lce la bstim/ so dang ljags la ḍāk+ki bsgoms pas gar byed pa dang*/ rang nyid rnam 'joms su gsal bas gzungs ring bzla/ zhig gling gi sme brtsegs bsgom bzlas dang*/ gnam chos kyi lo gyon bsgom bzlas byas pas grib dang*/ rims nad mi 'byung ba la zab/ theg chen byang sems kyi nyes ltung phra mo sbyong ba la nyin mtshan dus drug tu phung po gsum pa'i mdo btang dgos pas ltung bshags tshar gcig gi 'phros su/ zur gnyis sam don gnyis ldan smon 'jug byang chub sems bskyed kyis kun slong legs par bcos/

thun mgor bla ma la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ spyi bor bla ma bzhugs pa la dmigs nas/ da lta'i bstan pa 'di bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can gyi bka' drin las byung bas thub pas bstod pa 'bri gung skyob pas mdzad pa'i thabs mkhas thugs rje dang*/ dpal ldan jo bo rje a ti shas mdzad pa'i gang tshe rkang gnyis ma gang rung gtang*/ (404) bod gangs can ljongs su rgyal ba'i bstan pa spel ba la sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma 'byung gnas bka' drin che bas byang gter le'u bdun ma'i sku gsum gsol 'debs dang*/ nyi ma lho nub ma dang*/ bla ma dgongs 'dus las byung ba'i phur tshugs gsol 'debs/ hrīḥ dus gsum gyi sogs dang*/ mi 'gyur rdo rjes mdzad pa'i tshes bcu'i gsol 'debs dang*/ sprul sku ba mkhal smug po'i gter byon bar chad lam sel don bsdus dang*/ rje dbang grags rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i gsol 'debs/ mkhas grub ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i sgyu 'phrul gsol 'debs/ bka' brgyud gser phreng*/ byang gter rdzogs chen dgongs pa zang thal brgyud 'debs/ smar tshang phyag chen brgyud 'debs/ rong ston bsod nams dpal ba'i pad gling rdzogs chen kun bzang dgongs 'dus brgyud 'debs skye med ma/ dbang grags rgya mtsho'i 'brug lugs phyag chen brgyud 'debs/ mi 'gyur rdo rje/ chags med rin po che/ kun bzang shes rab/ lhun grub rgya mtsho/ pad+ma nor bu/ karma bkra shis rnams kyi gsol 'debs/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol 'debs kun bzang shes rab kyis mdzad pa'i bde stong spros bral ma bcas zin nas/ bla ma 'od du (405) zhu/ rang la thim pas thugs yid dbyer med du 'dres pa'i ngang la gzhag de nas rnam rtog zhig ldang ba dang*/ da lta'i dal 'byor bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i lus rten 'di phyin chad rgyu dpe grangs gsum la dpyad na rnyed par dka'/ gling gzhan gyi tshe la nges pa yod kyang*/

'dzam bu gling pa'i tshe la ngais pa med pas nam 'chi cha med/ shi nas dge sdig gi las bsags tshul la bsam na dge ba ni nyin skar tsam dkon/ sdig pa ni mtshan mo'i skar ma tsam zhar dang zhor du 'grub pas 'gro sa 'khor ba dang ngan song las 'os med/ der ni sdug bsngal sha stag las med pas rang phung rang brlag mi bya bar/ dge ba'i las sgrub nus par gyur cig snyam du rig 'dzin chen po mi 'gyur rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sngon 'gro ngag 'don thar pa'i gru gzings ma'i kye ma 'khor ba thar med sogs 'daun/ spyir 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa/ dgos rang don zhi bde'i 'jigs pa/ nying dgos tha mal 'khrul rtog gi 'jigs pa skyob nus pa bla ma dkon mchog yin pas mthor btang dmar btang skyid sdug legs nyes ci mdzad bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen snyam pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar chos sku sogs kyis skyabs yul gsal gdab/ na mo/ dus gsum rgyun chad med par sogs (406) kyi skyabs 'gro ci mang 'don/ skyabs yul dpang por byas pa'i mdun du sngon gyi rgyal ba sras bcas kyi rjes su slob ste smon 'jug byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas/ na mo 'gro ba kun don ma lan gsum/ sngar skyabs yul gsal ba tshogs zhing du byas nas/ snang tshul sprul sku'i maṇ+ḍal/ gnas tshul longs sku'i maṇ+ḍal/ khyab byed chos sku'i maṇ+ḍal rnams dbul bar bgyi'o snyam pas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sogs brjod nas tshogs zhing rang la bstim/ rang nyid tha mal gyi spyi bor bla ma rdor sems bsgom zhing de la skyabs su 'gro/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i sems bskyed pa rten gyi stobs/ sngar byas la 'gyod pa rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ phyin chad bsdom sems bya ba sdom pa'i stobs/ yig brgyas gsol ba btab pas rdor sems kyi sku'i bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyong gnyen po kun spyod kyi stobs dang ldan pas/

rang nyid tha mal spyi gtsug sogs dang yig brgya brgya'am nyer gcig spyi bo'i rdor sems rang la thim pas rang nyid rdor sems gsal bas don gnyis sgrub pa'i dmigs pas/ rang nyid sgrib dag rdo rje sems dpa'i sku// dkar gsal rdor sems 'dzin pa gong ltar gyur// ces dang*/ yig drug (407) brgya tsam/ mthar bsdu rim dmigs pas/ snod bcud rdor sems rdor sems yig brgya la// yig brgya hūm̐ la hūm̐ yig rang la thim// zhes dang*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub gyur sogs brjod/ 'di'i tshig bzhi go rim cung zad dkrugs pa ni spyan ras gzigs chags med rin po che'i khrid yig ltar byas/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor bla ma pad+ma 'byung gnas bsgom zhing*/ rang gi spyi gtsug sogs dang*/ 'dir spro na chags med rin po che'i dgongs pa ltar tshig bdun gsol 'debs kyi spyan 'dren dang*/ yang snying 'dus pa'i yan lag bcu pa/ hrīḥ bla ma yi dam tsam btang kyang 'gal ba med pa'i steng legs cha dang ldan no/ de nas/ bla ma khyed ni sangs rgyas kun 'dus/ chos kyi 'byung gnas/ dge 'dun gyi mnga' bdag skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i spyi gzugs lags pas/ bdag sogs sems can sdug bsngal gyis gdungs ba rnams la thugs rjes gzigs su gsol snyam pas gnam chos bka' gter gsol 'debs/ rdzogs chen sangs rgyas lag 'chang brgyud 'debs/ rat+na'i thugs sgrub sku gsum sgrub pa'i gsol 'debs/ ma nam bzhi skor/ rgyang 'bod tshan tshun rnams kyi bar bar sid+dhi brgya re bzla/ dbang bzhi len pa'i dmigs pa bcas/ (408) spyi gtsug nyi zla'i sogs nas/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang dang 'dres pas thugs rgyud kyi byin rlabs thams cad zhugs byung snyam pas/ spyi gtsug gu ru 'od zhu sogs kyis cung zad mnyam par gzhag slar spyi bor gsal zhing*/ dpal ldan rdo rje'i dgongs gter thugs kyi klong gsal gyi sman lha'i sgrub thabs 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dngos mi yi sha tshugs 'dzin pa snying rje'i dbang phyug chags med rin po che'i yig cha ltar gtong*/

de nas de'i yig cha ltar sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul gzhi kun bzang 'od dpag med kyi sgrub thabs kyi cho ga gtang*/ thog mar chos sgrub pa po rig 'dzin tshe yi dngos grub snyen dgos pas chos rgyal rat+na gling pa'i zab gter dam chos 'dus pa skor bzhi'i ya rgyal tshe sgrub gsang ba 'dus pa'i yang gsang gud sbas dang mi 'gyur rdo rje'i tshe sgrub gang rung dang*/ gangs can bod kyi lha skal spyan ras gzigs yi dam snying por dgos pas/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyi gsung sprul gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gi dam chos 'dus pa skor dgu'i bcud phur thugs rje (409) chen po yang snying 'dus pa'i phrin las sam/ rgya mtsho lha lnga gang rung*/ de nas bla sgrub thams cad kyi rgyal po gu ru rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sgrub thabs nyams su len dgos pas gnam chos mtshan brgyad chig dril lam/ nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang po'i rnam 'phrul rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po'i zab gter thams cad kyi snying po'i yang zhun dkon mchog spyi 'dus gtong dgos pas/ thog mar rgya rnga 'ur thung ngu dang*/ (Musical notes and signs here) na mo/ rang gi spyi bor sogs nas sngags mchod mthar rol mo byin rlabs kyi tshul du rnga 'ur sum rdung gis rnga 'don byas la skyabs sems 'phros sum rdung*/ mtshams gcod 'phros/ (Musical notes and signs here) spyan 'dren mgor 'ur/ (Musical notes and signs here) mchod pa'i mthar 'ur dgu rdung*/ bstod pa'i mthar/ dgu rdung gsum/ 'ur sum rdung gis de nas gzhag de nas gsol 'debs dzapra/ tshe sgrub bcas sbyor/ mchod bstod bya/ de nas thun dngos la gnam chos sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don gter gzhung lta bu zhig btang nas/ rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog 'phros su/ bum dbang gi lam bskyed bzlas skabs yin na/ de'i (410) rgyun khyer lta bu'i brgyud 'debs/

skyabs sems/ yan bdun/ bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor 'don dus bsnyen mtshams lta bu yin na mtshams ma grol bar srung 'khor mi bsdu/ byin 'beb/ mchod rlabs/ lha bskyed/ spyan 'dren/ bzhugs phyag mchod bstod 'phros/ dmigs pa bcas dzapra la zhugs dgos pas/ bsnyen pa'i thog mar phreng ba byin rlabs/ mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying bzla ba sogs bsnyen pa'i lag len bskyed rim dmigs skor go don blang ba rig 'dzin chen po 'jigs med gling pa'i bskyed rim 'og min bgrod pa'i them skal/ a bu tshang gi dga' 'grel/ srog sdom gzer bzhi/ 'bri gung chos grags pa'i snyen sgrub spyi gces/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rdo rje 'chang gi bskyed rim dang bsnyen pa'i lag len/ nyag rong mkhar ba sprul sku'i las byang dmigs rnam/ dge paṇa gyi bskyed rim zung 'jug snye ma rnams bzhin lag tu blang*/ thun mthar mchod bstod/ nongs bshags/ bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon/ bkra shis bcas thun kun la dgos/ gsang sher lam rtsa rlung nyams len can yin na/ gnam chos khro bo ro za'i rtsa rlung khrid yig bde drod rang 'bar sogs chags med yab sras rnams kyi gsung dang*/ klong chen snying thig gi bde stong rlung gi (411) rdzogs rim skor dang*/ gzhan yang bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi rtsa rlung rdo rje'i drwa mig rat+na'i thugs sgrub kyi rim lnga'i gtum mo sogs gang 'dod nyams su blang*/ dbang bzhi pa'i lam rdzogs pa chen po sgom pa yin na bla ma'i man ngag las byung ba bzhin du nyams su blangs nas thun la zhugs dgos/ nam gsal ba dang thun mjug bsdu/ ltung bshags tshar gcig dang*/ spros bral bde chen ma gtang*/ thun dung bdun 'bud sngar ltar dang*/ rgya rnga 'ur bdun rdung gong ltar 'phros nyin mtshan dus drug la sems bskyed sdom chog blang ba'i dod rnga 'ur sum rdung gis/ bla dgongs 'dus kyi skyabs 'gro kye kye ma dang*/

yan lag bdun pa 'das byon 'phros sum rdung*/ 'gro mgon chos 'phags gsung*/ maṇ+ḍal so bdun rnga 'don gyi bla ma sku khams mthar/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs lan gsum dang*/ rgya btsun nam mkha' rgya mtsho'i gsung*/ ji ltar sngon gyi rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa gang bslabs pa/ de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob cing*/ byang chub sems mchog rab tu skyed par bgyi/ zhes pa lan gsum nang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom pa bcas mthar rnga 'ur sum rdung gis 'jog de nas so byang sngags gsum gyi nyes ltung phyir bcos jo bo rje'i spyi bshags/ u hu hu lags so/ (412)zhes pa 'di a ti sha'i gre sig yin pas 'don mi dgos/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs la yig brgya tshar gcig la ting shag 'ur rdung dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod pa bka' rtags kyi phyag len nyams len chu sbyin gtong ba la/ thog mar bzang spyod las byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun pa chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gsung*/ sa gzhi spos chus ma dang*/ sku gsum yongs rdzogs= bla ma sku khams bcas tshogs bsags spyir gtang*/ chu gtor dngos ni gtor ma brgya rtsa'i don bsdus gnam chos chu gtor la theb gshal/ kha gshal 'phros/ theb bzhir gtor ril dang*/ gcig stong par 'jog pa rnams kyi nang du chu blug bzhin/ skyabs sems dang*/ bdag nyid kha sar pa ṇi/ ma ṇi brgya/ hūm̐/ rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs sogs nas/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho snod dang po dgang*/ ting shag gnyis rdung byos la gtor ril blugs/ gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi snod gnyis pa dgang*/ ting shag gsum rdeg byos la gtor ril blugs/ gtor ma 'jig rten skyong ba snod gsum pa dgang*/ ting shag bzhi rdeg byos la gtor ril blugs/ gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan la bzhi pa lnga par dgang*/ ting shag gnyis thing*/

'ur thung byos la bzhi pa stong pa dang*/ lnga pa gtor ril (413) blugs pa thams cad chus dgang*/ jo bo rje'i dzam dkar chu sbyin rtsa sngags la bzhi par dzam sku bzhugs steng chu sbreng*/ gtor 'bul lnga par bya/ dngos grub chu bkyags nas len byas nas thams cad gtor ril dang chus dgang*/ zhi byed kyi dam pa'i brul gtor la 'byung bzhi glud bcas re re bzhin gshegs rjes gshal chus gshal/ theb sbub steng chu lhag blugs/ rang nyid spyan ras sogs la chu dang me rlung sa la sats+tsha gdab/ gsol ja la bla ma dgongs 'dus gsol 'debs smin gling gter chen rin po ches ja mchod du bsgyur ba/ hrīḥ dus gsum ma gtang*/ de nas rgya rnga sngar ltar/ rnga 'ur sum rdung gis chags med rgyun bsang lta bu'i byin rlabs 'phros/ 'ur bdun rdung*/ man rnga spyi 'gros/ mthar 'ur sum rdung dang*/ phrin bcol mthar/ (Musical notes and signs here) gnam chos rgyun bsang bh+rūm̐ yig ma mthar/ (Musical notes and signs here) nyis brtsegs/ 'ur sum rdung gis 'jog de ni mgron bzhi mchod pas dgyes pas byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi ba'i dgos pa yod/ de nas ḍā dril gyis/ rat+na'i gur drag lta bus mtshon chag tu mi rung ba'i rgyun khyer rnams gtang*/ de nas nyi ma la shar lung shar nas snga thun sdom dgos pas (414) thun dung bdun 'bud dang*/ thun 'di'i nang do gal che yang thun dral nas mi rgyug snyam pa'i dam bca' bya/ lus gnad chos bdun/ ngag gnad rlung ro bsal/ sems gnad kun slong 'chos pa ni/ da ga re ngas thun bcad pa 'di tshe 'di'i nad sogs zhi ba'i phyir 'jigs skyob kyi kun slong de yin nam/ tshe ring ba sogs legs smon gyi kun slong yin/ de yin na mi dge'i kun slong yin pas dug ltar spong*/ lung ma bstan gyi kun slong ci dran 'di dran med pa de red 'dug na 'chos/ dge ba'i kun slong skyes bu chung ngu'i ngan song las thar nas mngon mtho sgrub 'dod des kyang 'das lam mi 'ong*/

skyes bu 'bring gi 'khor ba las thar nas/ rang don zhi bde 'dod pas kyang theg chen lam zhugs mi 'ong*/ da bdag rang gi don ma yin pas/ sems can thams cad mar shes/ drin dran drin lan gsab 'dod kyis sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral nas mtha' gnyis las 'das pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gi lam zab mo nyams su len par bgyi'o snyam pa'i smon 'jug sems bskyed/ bla ma spyi bor sgom/ gsol 'debs gang mos bya/ mthar bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim (415) pas thugs rgyud kyi yon tan rang gi rgyud la skyes byung snyam du cung zad gzhag de nas rnam rtog cig ldang ba dang sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don dang dbang bzhi'i nyams len gong du bshad pa ltar nyams su len/ nyin gung dus thun grol ran dus/ da res thun 'di'i nang bsgoms pa'i dge rtsas mtshon/ zag bcas zag med kyi dge rtsa thams cad phyogs gcig tu dril nas ma sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob pa'i phyir tu rgyal ba sras bcas kyi rjes su slob nas bsngo'o snyam pas bzang spyod smon lam 'daun/ da lta'i dam bca' byas pa de ral lam ma ral snyam pa'i bsngo bgrang byed/ legs par song ba'i nga rgyal bcag ma song ba'i spro bsring*/ ltung bshags tshar gcig de nas thun dung bdun 'bud/ rgya rnga 'ur bdun rdung*/ rnga 'ur bdun rdung gis/ bzang spyod yan bdun/ maṇ+ḍal sa gzhi ma sogs byang sdom len tshul sngar ltar mthar/ bdun rdung gsum/ 'ur sum rdung gis gzhag kar gling zhi khro'i chos spyod bag chags rang grol/ bar do'i rtsa tshig sogs kyi rang lus lhar gsal/ bsam pa lhun grub ma dang*/ rig 'dzin chen po 'jigs med gling pa'i zab gter rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying thig las byung ba'i bsam pa myur 'grub/ mtsho dbus ge sar ma/ (416) rdo grub chen rin po che kun bzang gzhan phan gyis gu ru rin po ches zhal gzigs dus mdzad pa'i o rgyan rin po che la gsol ba 'debs sogs brjod/

mdo sngags gang rung lugs kyi gung tshigs bzhes/ mthar zab mdo bdud bzlog dang*/ ltung bshags/ zhi khro bshags chung dang*/ sgrol ma 'daun/ phyi thun sdom ran pa dang*/ thun dung bdun 'bud/ thun gyi sngon 'grau bzhi dang*/ lho nub rnga yab ma dang*/ sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don dang*/ dbang bzhi'i nyams len la thun du gcad/ de yang dbang 'og ma'i nyams len rnam rtog lam du byed pa rnams la dpyad 'jog spel ma byed pa gzab/ thun mthar bsngo smon/ klu sgrub bde smon/ chags med bde smon rnams dang*/ byams smon rkang gnyis ma/ zhi byed smon lam sum cu ma/ mkha' 'gro snying thig gi smon lam/ mkhan chen bo dhi satwa'i sman chog smon lam/ dgongs zang smon lam/ dgongs 'dus smon lam/ kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i smon lam/ mi 'gyur rdo rje'i smon lam sogs bka' dang bstan bcos las byung ba'i smon lam khyad par can rnams brjod/ thun dung bdun 'bud/ rgya rnga 'ur bdun rdung*/ (417) rnga 'ur dgu rdung gis yang snying 'dus pa'i yan lag bcu pa/ hrīḥ bla ma yi dam dang maṇ+ḍal sa gzhi ma sogs byang sdom len chog sngar ltar mthar/ rnga dgu rdung gsum/ 'ur sum rdung gis 'jog de nas dal gcig ngal gso nas yang rgya rnga 'ur rdung*/ rnga 'ur sum rdung gis gnam chos rtsa gsum las byang gi dbu nas brtsams/ bgegs bskrad mthar/ (Musical notes and signs here) rten bskyed mthar/ (Musical notes and signs here) lha bskyed mthar/ (Musical notes and signs here) spyan 'dren mthar/ (Musical notes and signs here) bzhugs gsol mthar/ (Musical notes and signs here) phyag 'tshal mthar/ (Musical notes and signs here) mchod pa mthar 'ur/ (Musical notes and signs here) bstod pa mthar/ (Musical notes and signs here) bshags pa mthar 'ur sum rdung gis 'jog bsnyen pa la zhugs/ de yang da nangs gur drag ma song na 'dir gnam chos gur drag gsang sgrub 'dzud/
